text:
incident-bot: HIGH: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream in eu-west-1. Alerting oncall. Metric: p99=3.5s, p95=1.2s, streaming stall count increased. Affected model shard group: redwood-7b-int8-calib-v3.

Aisha (oncall): acked — I'm taking triage. Paging SRE and ML infra. Anyone who touched quant/precision in the last hour? :eyes:

Tom B.: I pushed the int8 calibration v3 profile to eu-west-1 ~45m ago as part of the staged rollout. No canary anomalies at the time. Rolling back in progress if we confirm impact.

Maya R.: adding quick telemetry snapshot. KV cache evictions spiked at the same time as stalls, see inline logs.

Maya R.: ```
kv_cache.evictions: 482 -> 2300
serve.stream.stalls: 2 -> 38
model.redwood-7b-int8-calib-v3.latency.p99: 3500ms
node_gpu_mem_free: -1.2GB (transient)
```

Ravi K.: That pattern looks like calibration changed a kernel path that increases KV footprint or causes more KV churn on long-context streams. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) route streaming traffic to redwood-7b-fp16 fallback in eu-west-1, 2) disable the v3 calibration rollout for int8, 3) bump kv cache capacity on hot nodes or force a rolling cache-resize.

Aisha (oncall): Good call. Tom, can you run a rollback and create a routing override? I'll notify CS for customer impact.

Tom B.: Running rollback now. Command I used:
```bash
# pin region routing to fp16 variant for streaming endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","route":"/v1/stream","model":"redwood-7b-fp16","ttl":900}'
```
Applying...

Tom B.: Override applied. Also disabling calibration rollout flag for int8 in eu-west-1: `calib.int8.v3.enabled=false`

incident-bot: ACTION: routing override created by Tom B. — id=ovr-5409876543-1. Notifying oncall and ops.

Maya R.: After routing flip, p99 dropped to ~900ms within two minutes, stalls reduced. However some sessions saw partial chunks delayed (client side timeouts). Need to check long-lived KV state consistency.

Aisha (oncall): CS update: a handful of customers reported streaming interruptions and retry errors. No large-scale data loss. Triage severity: P1 (customer-impacting latency). Eng-sre oncall assigned.

Ravi K.: Looking at node-level traces — the int8-calib-v3 path is doing extra dequant steps that allocate temporary buffers per token, increasing memory pressure and causing more frequent KV eviction. We should add a protective guard in the runtime to avoid synchronous deallocations during streaming. For now, routing to fp16 is the safest.

Tom B.: Agreed. I'm collecting a short postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (calib v3 increases KV working set), mitigations (rollback, routing), follow-ups (runtime guard + synthetic long-context load test).

Maya R.: Captured a minimal repro: long (>2048) context with heavy prefix reuse triggers eviction cascade. Repro snippet attached to internal ticket.

Aisha (oncall): Oncall handoff plan: I'm coordinating immediate mitigations; Dmitri, you'll take next shift and own the deeper fix if we're green on customer-facing metrics. I'll do a warm handoff in 30m.

Dmitri S.: acked. Will pick this up for root cause and patch work tomorrow EU morning.

Tom B.: Quick note: rolled a targeted hotfix to reduce per-token temporary allocations in int8 path for v3 but keeping it disabled until we validate in staging. Patch id: patch-5409876543-rc1.

Maya R.: We also observed an uptick in retry loops from SDKs when chunked responses are delayed — need to coordinate with SDK team to make retry windows tunable during rollouts.

Aisha (oncall): Current status: routing override active, canary disabled, p99 trending down to 800-1000ms. CS notified. SRE to monitor for 1 hour, after which we'll consider controlled re-intro of calib v3 to a tiny subset with KV guard.

Tom B.: Adding follow-ups to ticket: 
- add runtime guard to avoid per-token large temp allocs (owner: eng-runtime)
- extend calibration rollout checks with KV eviction metric gating (owner: eng-ml)
- add long-context synthetic tests to CI (owner: eng-ml + eng-sre)
- SDK retry guidance update (owner: devex)

incident-bot: HANDOFF: Aisha (oncall) -> Dmitri S. at 5409877000. Incident remains active, paging cleared.

Dmitri S.: I'll start a focused debug tomorrow. Please drop any logs/repro in the ticket thread. Also propose a postmortem doc and a small runbook entry for "calibration-induced kv eviction".

Aisha (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem + action owners in the ticket. Will keep this thread open for any late regressions. :white_check_mark:
